name: rozo
description: Rozo AI skills for agents that pay with crypto.

plugins.name: rozo-checkout
plugins.description: Pay OpenRouter and other AI services (Coinbase payment links), or a Bitrefill invoice, with the crypto you already hold: USDT/USDC on Solana, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Polygon or Arbitrum, USDC on Base or Stellar, BTC over Lightning, or native ETH (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum), BNB, SOL or POL. No Coinbase account needed. A Bitrefill invoice (up to 1050 USDC) costs the invoice amount plus a 1% Rozo service fee, rounded up to the cent, and takes the same coins as the router accepts for that invoice (not ZEC).
